book.name: Lukas
book.title: Xoulek Nimza wei Lukas byex o

content: Yesu umbek
Eivek bouk tiyon eno Sisa Ogastus king wei ngandoung o wong petieing ti la me neil embei xel a qou moux alis vex dalus wei tembuing sapa wei dei xeinghembi eivek Rom eno leind eivek qapiya.
(Inye myaxeeng selis wei xel qou xel leind gyeik ingwei Kwirinius wo lei ngandoung wei seyap wei Siria yo.)
Me xel dalusateiv la venaxow bend qes bei seyap a qou xel leind.
Yosep on neumambu wei king Dawit o. Om la veil beyeeng Nasaret eivek Galili, me lek me la Yudia, la Dawit beeng wei Betelem o.
Moxo la inyei is Maria wei xel tup qayeeng lekti bei e mendei wou e yo bei seyap a qou luw leind, gyeik inyon eno Maria xei qou veil.
Ka luw la toundei inyei, eno bouk la wou eivek ingwei yakyeis on embei dumbek o.
Om vexo wou neu touk, me beliv e eivek qaeing me liw eivek manghaxo xe dipek, en xomek wei vateivek o pup zeyi xel.
Xel gyovaxa wei sipsip o me angelayeiw
Me nanghei inyei eno xel gyovaxa wei sipsip eno valu toundei myayaing veil beyeeng, me di yeiteyei xel xe sipsip qendu ngandoung on eivek boukeing tiyon.
Dekakom Tambiy Ngandoung xe angela ti lam wou xel, me Tambiy Ngandoung xe xeiyaing ngandoung lam siing e vivekwou xel, om xel yaleeng ngandoung.
Ekom angela neil wou xel bei, “Xam seng gwaleeng. En a qou xoulek nimza me na lam wou xam, bei embong xomaxoneing dalus bo xeindlala ngandoung.
Gweimbeeng kane eivek beyeeng nayak wei Dawit xe eno tambiy tiwei qou xam ghe lam veil nilul eno umbek en xam. E Kilisi
me Tambiy Ngandoung.
Tyek xam ghe boulek dee nambei nye: Tyek xam ghe gwei yakyeis ti xel beliv eivek vetivek mati me liw eivek manghaxo xe dipek.”
De lutika eno angela ngenongakes wei tyoung gheyapu eno lam is angela tiyon, me xel sanghoxe Anutu me neil embei,

content.text: “Xey a sanghoxe Anutu lei na gheyapu nei,
de nanghei tembuing eno xomaxoneing wei Anutu lalei wo nimza wou xel eno na mi mendei is laleind vevopeing.”

content: Xel gyovaxa wei sipsip o la yei Yesu

Gyeik ingwei xel angela lox veil xel me la eivek tyoung gheyapu nei, eno xel gyovaxa wei sipsip o neil wouma bei, “Xey a la Betelem me na xei lul tiwei qandi nei, wei Tambiy Ngandoung neil wou xey en o.”
Om xel la daing me la yeiwou Maria luw Yosep, me yakyeis wei di yeip eivek manghaxo xe dipek o.
Gyeik ingwei xel yei e, eno xel neil qayeeng la wo sapa en vatiyeiw wei angela neil wou xel en yakyeis tiyon o.
Me xel dalus wei ngo inye, eno etek en vati wei xel gyovaxa wei sipsip o neil wou xel o.
Ekom Maria mi zeimaxoun qayeeng ti beimambei yon dalus eivek lalei me mi wounalei en.
Xel gyovaxa wei sipsip eno lox me la me di sanghoxe Anutu me wong xeindlala en lulul dalus wei xel ngo me yei yo. Nambei kawei angela neil wou xel o.
Xel taxe Yesu lei
Lek bouk lim yal, gyeik bouk wei xel embei ghuw yak on ninavi me taxe e lei Yesu. Lei yon angela wong gyeik ingwei se ghei mi eivek ta veis o.
Simion aluw Ana yei Yesu eivek xomek vambuing

Gyeik bouk lam tyip en ingwei yeing wou xow bo vako wou Anutu manghalus teyei lek Mose xe petieing eno la wou eivek, om Yosep aluw Maria qou Yesu me la Yerusalem en embei na bong e na wou Tambiy Ngandoung.
Inyon nambei xel byex eivek Tambiy Ngandoung xe petieing, “Xel yak moux sapa wei umbek atax eno xam ghe bong ena nambei vambuing wou Tambiy Ngandoung nambei e xe.”
Me luw la sei xound nambei vati wei xel neil eivek Tambiy Ngandoung xe petieing o, “beliy yayuw o banax lingheing yayuw.”

Gweimbeeng eivek Yerusalem eno tambiy ti mindei e lei Simion, tambiy on mindei bombek me mi wong lalo. Moxo mi axe ingwei Mesia embei bong lalei vevopeing wou Israel o, me Laweeng Vambuing mindei eivek e.
Laweeng Vambuing talex wou e bei, tyek se mey qe ka gyei Tambiy Ngandoung xe Kilisi bole.
Laweeng Vambuing zeim e lalei lek, me e la eivek tete lalei wei xomek vambuing, de Yesu ma luw ta qou e me la en embei na bong vati wou e nambei kwa wei petieing neil o.
Me Simion qava e me sanghoxe Anutu me neil:

content.text: “Tambiy Ngandoung, wei ghanaw veil, nambei ingwei wang neil zonghek o, wang bong wa xe xukxe na mey eivek lalei vevopeing.
En a manghalus yei wa xe tambiy wei embei devind xa veil nilul o,
wei wang xupexe inye wou xomaxoneing dalus mend o.
E xeiyaing tiwei embei talex enam yanyateiv wou xel amba
de bong wa xe xel Israel leind zekna.”

content: Yesu ma luw ta etek en qayeeng vati wei neil lek e yo.

Woyom Simion wo mata wou lal me neil wou moxo ta Maria, “Yakyeis tine nambei beyaleing wei tyek bong xel ngenong detei de xel ngenong qandi lek eivek Israel, me tyek mendei nambei dee ti, wei xel ngenong tyek bo vyend wou e yo.
En kandek xel ngenong xe laleind peyei eno tyek nam yanyateiv. De ngeyeing vevek ti tyek beum wamaxow num pieing is.”
Nanghei inyon eno poropet vex ti e lei Ana, Penuel neu vex eivek velei wei Asal o. Vexo wo vexta, vexo mindei is leya teyei lek vakovek qes lim yuw takwei gyeik ingwei luw iima yo.
De woyom wo vexeiv teyei lek 84 vakovek qes. Vexo se mindei veil xomek vambuing qe mi wong lalo boukeing aluw bendiyeing, me mi vambu yaeing de mi zeimema.
Lek bouk kayon eno la paviy xel me wong dange wou Anutu me luk en yakyeis on wou xel dalus wei mi toung mend en ingwei Anutu embei tul xel Yerusalem veil nilul o.
Yosep lox me la Nasaret
Gyeik ingwei Yosep me Maria wong lulul dalus la teyei lek petieing wei Tambiy Ngandoung xe yo, luw lox Galili me lox me la luw venaxow xe beyeeng nayak Nasaret.
Me yakyeis on wo teiv me wo nikanzek. Moxo pup en lupeyei nimza me Anutu xe lalei xeiles toundei eivek e.
Yak ghavis Yesu la xomek vambuing
Teyei lek vakovek qes sapa eno moxo ma luw ta mi la Yerusalem en embei na gyei mata ngandoung wei Pasova yo.
Gyeik Yesu xe vakovek qes xoumeeng yuw, eno xel betiwou xel xe kwa me lek me la yei mata ngandoung wei Pasova yon.
Ka bouk ngandoung wei mata dalus la veil, eno ma luw ta lox me la bend, de Yesu nanghei toundei Yerusalem, ekom luw se woulek inye.
Luw wou naleind bei la is moux alis vex valu, xel la e teyei lek bouk ti, woyom luw yimexe e eivek nipapu me luw xe gweleeng senghoing.
Gyeik ingwei luw se yeiwou e, luw lox me la Yerusalem en embei nox gyimexe e.
Ka bouk yayal la veil eno luw yeiwou e nanghei tete lalei wei xomek vambuing o, toundei eivek xel putoung senghoing, di ngo xel me di wo telinyeing wou xel.
Xel sapa wei ngo e xe qayeeng eno etek en e xe lupeyei me qayeeng bombek wei di neil elox o.
Gyeik ingwei ma luw ta yei e, eno luw etek. Moxo ta neil wou e bei, “Touk, nambei nya wang wong ambei nyon wou uw? Uw mam laleimi wo maying en wang om uw a mi ximexe wang.”
Moxo teling wou luw, “Nambei nya muw ghe mi wimexe ay? Muw seng woulek bei a toundei eivek mang beeng?”
Ekom luw se woulek vati wei di neil wou luw o.
Woyom lep me la xo Nasaret nei is luw me mi betiwou luw xe qayeeng. Ekom moxo ta mi toung lulti beimambei yon dalus eivek lalei me mi wounalei en.
Me Yesu wo teiv is lupeyei nimza, me Anutu lalei wo nimza wou e me moux alis vex laleind wo nimza wou e is.

footnotes.text: Kilisi Eivek qayeeng wei Hibru eno xel neil, Mesia. Qes, tambiy wei Anutu beyal bei e qou xomaxoneing noum o.
